name: Ševětín (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a white upper hoist part bearing a red rose with yellow centre and a blue lower fly part bearing a yellow church tower with black roof.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 29 May 2007 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
